page.overview:
Who is Kevin?

The Japanese language|dislikes=Demons|status=Unknown}}Kevin (ケビン Kebin?) is the first character created in the "Street Fighter Laboratory" corner. He is a 13-year-old middle schooler. He uses a needle as a weapon, and has the ability to miniaturize himself, using his speed to his advantage. He also admires Japan and its culture.

Behind him, there's a Wadōkaichin, the oldest Japanese type of coin, roughly 2,4 cm in diameter. Category:Concept Characters Category:Characters
